incidentForm.sev.heading: Auto-classified severity
incidentForm.sev.s1.label: Level 1 (S1)
incidentForm.sev.s1.def: Impacts company or customer sensitive information; impacts systems, networks or users in other OpCos; impacts local critical systems or core network; disrupts a critical internal or OS process; likely to reach media and affect Group reputation.
incidentForm.sev.s2.label: Level 2 (S2)
incidentForm.sev.s2.def: Impacts company or customer non-sensitive information; impacts non-critical local or customer systems and access-layer networks; affects a non-critical local or OS business process.
incidentForm.sev.s3.label: Level 3 (S3)
incidentForm.sev.s3.def: No impact on company or customer information; impacts a non-critical local system without business interruption; indicates a potential threat of imminent attack.
